title: Boucherville municipal pier (Yvon Julien)
specs: Proof of residence required for free fare on Île Grosbois shuttle
Children under 14 must be accompanied by a person 14 or older with valid ticket
blurb: Three shuttle routes depart from the Yvon-Julien pier in Boucherville. The shuttles transport up to 45 people each. Services operate seasonally with varying schedules and prices depending on the route.
extraNote: Reservations strongly recommended · Tickets can be purchased online or on board (cash only) for Île Grosbois shuttle · Service free on Montréal-Mercier shuttle as mitigation during tunnel works · Quai Yvon-Julien, Boucherville · Summer season with specific dates per route
